description: Dataset Riolering Assen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Assen. Datasets van rioolgegevens gemeente Assen. Herkomst Riodesk (Kikker) Bijgewerkt 12-01-2022. Coverage: Gemeente Assen. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Assen. Its tags are Assen, Hemelwater, Riolering, Riool, Vuilwater. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/KML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/SHP, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC. The portal shows 2022-04-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
